correctness.rationale: For m>=4 every four-set induces boundary of the six-vertex five-simplex. Every four-coloring defines a simplicial edge map because the mapped cover witnesses meet all mapped edges, including collapsed-color edges. Rainbow restrictions induce +1 on H4 because every transposition on four original vertices is even on six graph edges; non-rainbow restrictions have at most four distinct image vertices and induce zero. The Fourier sum with i to the sum of four chosen colors isolates exactly -24*4^(m-4) times any coefficient. Hence all C(m,4) cycles independent. Jonsson Theorem 7.1 proves the exact rational dimension C(m,4), yielding a basis. Relabeling is orientation preserving, so the complete character counts fixed four-subsets. Exact finite tests and the source rank statement are recorded; the all-m proof does not rely on interpolation.

originality.rationale: Jonsson gives the complete integral ranks but not, in the inspected theorem statement, a full relabeling character; Biswas studies nonequivariant Čech homotopy. The new claim identifies explicit tetrahedral four-sphere cycles as a rational geometric basis and computes the full S_m degree-four character. The coloring-retraction/Fourier isolation proof supplies a nontrivial comparison not implied by Betti numbers. The earlier full text was not completely accessible, so equivalent buried work remains a documented risk.
